tagline: A sun-drenched desert downtown of murals, museums and big-league games, at its best from October to April.

events.name: First Friday
events.desc: Galleries and studios along Roosevelt Row and Grand Avenue open their doors on the first Friday evening of each month.

events.name: Arizona Matsuri
events.desc: A weekend festival of Japanese culture in Margaret T. Hance Park, with taiko drumming, food and crafts.

events.name: Art Detour
events.desc: A long-running celebration of the city's arts scene, with open studios, gallery shows and performances.

events.name: Arizona State Fair
events.desc: Rides, livestock shows, fair food and concerts at the state fairgrounds just north-west of downtown.
